providerType.description: Output only. Specifies the provider type.

isDisabled.description: Optional. Whether the merchant disabled this link. Defaults to `false`, which means the link is enabled. If `provider_type` is `AGGREGATOR_3P`, the merchant can disable or enable this link through `UpdatePlaceActionLink`. If `provider_type` is `MERCHANT`, this field is always `false` and `UpdatePlaceActionLink` rejects updates to it.

placeActionType.description: Required. The type of place action that can be performed using this link.

createTime.description: Output only. The time when the place action link was created.

name.description: Optional. The resource name, in the format `locations/{location_id}/placeActionLinks/{place_action_link_id}`. The name field will only be considered in UpdatePlaceActionLink and DeletePlaceActionLink requests for updating and deleting links respectively. However, it will be ignored in CreatePlaceActionLink request, where `place_action_link_id` will be assigned by the server on successful creation of a new link and returned as part of the response.

isEditable.description: Output only. Indicates whether this link can be edited by the client.

uri.description: Required. The link uri. The same uri can be reused for different action types across different locations. However, only one place action link is allowed for each unique combination of (uri, place action type, location).

updateTime.description: Output only. The time when the place action link was last modified.

isPreferred.description: Optional. Whether this link is preferred by the merchant. Only one link can be marked as preferred per place action type at a location. If a future request marks a different link as preferred for the same place action type, then the current preferred link (if any exists) will lose its preference.

placeActionLinks.description: The returned list of place action links.

nextPageToken.description: If there are more place action links than the requested page size, then this field is populated with a token to fetch the next page of results.

get.description: Gets the specified place action link.

name.description: Required. The name of the place action link to fetch.

updateMask.description: Required. The specific fields to update. The only editable fields are `uri`, `place_action_type`, `is_preferred` and `is_disabled`. If the updated link already exists at the same location with the same `place_action_type` and `uri`, fails with an `ALREADY_EXISTS` error.

name.description: Optional. The resource name, in the format `locations/{location_id}/placeActionLinks/{place_action_link_id}`. The name field will only be considered in UpdatePlaceActionLink and DeletePlaceActionLink requests for updating and deleting links respectively. However, it will be ignored in CreatePlaceActionLink request, where `place_action_link_id` will be assigned by the server on successful creation of a new link and returned as part of the response.

patch.description: Updates the specified place action link and returns it.

parent.description: Required. The resource name of the location where to create this place action link. `locations/{location_id}`.

create.description: Creates a place action link associated with the specified location, and returns it. The request is considered duplicate if the `parent`, `place_action_link.uri` and `place_action_link.place_action_type` are the same as a previous request.

list.description: Lists the place action links for the specified location.

filter.description: Optional. A filter constraining the place action links to return. The response includes entries that match the filter. We support only the following filter: 1. place_action_type=XYZ where XYZ is a valid PlaceActionType.

parent.description: Required. The name of the location whose place action links will be listed. `locations/{location_id}`.

pageSize.description: Optional. How many place action links to return per page. Default of 10. The minimum is 1.

pageToken.description: Optional. If specified, returns the next page of place action links.

delete.description: Deletes a place action link from the specified location.

name.description: Required. The resource name of the place action link to remove from the location.

list.description: Returns the list of available place action types for a location or country.

filter.description: Optional. A filter constraining the place action types to return metadata for. The response includes entries that match the filter. We support only the following filters: 1. location=XYZ where XYZ is a string indicating the resource name of a location, in the format `locations/{location_id}`. 2. region_code=XYZ where XYZ is a Unicode CLDR region code to find available action types. If no filter is provided, all place action types are returned.

pageToken.description: Optional. If specified, the next page of place action type metadata is retrieved. The `pageToken` is returned when a call to `placeActionTypeMetadata.list` returns more results than can fit into the requested page size.

languageCode.description: Optional. The IETF BCP-47 code of language to get display names in. If this language is not available, they will be provided in English.

pageSize.description: Optional. How many action types to include per page. Default is 10, minimum is 1.
